title: Ihamagarwa riturutse mu kibaya gitagatifu
intro: Hirya y'amateka hari inkuru y'umuntu wari uhagaze hagati y'umutegetsi ukomeye n'ubwoko bwose bwari bugizwe n'abacakara. Uyu muntu yahamagariwe kubohora igihugu igitugu, akora ibitangaza byasuzuguye amategeko yose asanzwe. Kuva ku musozi mutagatifu kugeza ku gitangaza hejuru y'amazi, uyu mugaragu wa Allah yabonye ibimenyetso byagiye byumvikanwa mu bihe bitandukanye. Inshingano yawe uyu munsi ni ukumenya uyu muntu udasanzwe wagize uruhare mu mateka y'abantu.
clues: Navutse mu gihe ubwoko bwanjye bwari buhanganye n'itegeko ry'urupfu, maze umuryango wanjye uranshyira mu mazi kugira ngo nkize ubuzima bwanjye.
Narabonetse kandi nkurira mu rugo rw'umutegetsi wategetse ko ubwoko bwanjye bwicwa.
Nahungiye ku musozi mutagatifu aho nabonye umuriro ku giti kitarakongoka, maze ijwi rimbwira riturutse muri wo.
Nasubijwe kuri uwo mutegetsi n'ibitangaza, nsaba ko ubwoko bwanjye bw'abacakara bubohorwa.
Nakubise inyanja nkoresheje inkoni yanjye, maze icikamo ibice byumutse, imira abakurikiraga abantu banjye.
Navuganye n'Umwami wanjye ku musozi mu gihe cy'amajoro mirongo ine, maze mpabwa ibisate by'ubuyobozi bw'Imana.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Abantu banjye bambutse inyanja bagana ahantu hatekanye
Umuriro w'umunyagitugu wabaye mwiza kandi urangwa n'amahoro
Inyanja yajugunye imbohe zayo ku nkombe
Uwafashwe mpiri yabaye umubitsi w'umutungo wa Misiri
